# Beta templates

Public, PII-free templates for the SPECTOR hardware beta.

| File | Use |
|------|-----|
| `beta-testers.csv` | Headers for the private roster (`private/beta-testers.csv`) |
| `beta-feedback.md` | Copy to `private/feedback/<tester_id>.md` per tester |
| `checklist-rayban-meta-gen.md` | Gen 1 / Gen 2 — phone rehearsal only |
| `checklist-rayban-meta-display.md` | Meta Display — on-lens unverified |
| `checklist-xreal-viture.md` | XREAL / Viture — mirror path |

Operator runbook: [`../BETA_TESTING.md`](../BETA_TESTING.md).
